data.title: KSrelief Distributes Food Baskets, Personal Hygiene Kits to Earthquake-Affected Families in Indonesia
data.content:
Jakarta, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 444 food baskets and 444 personal hygiene kits on Friday to people affected by the earthquake in West Satar Punda village, Manggarai Regency, on Indonesia's Flores Island, benefiting 1,776 individuals.
    The distribution was carried out as part of a relief assistance project for those affected by the earthquake on Flores Island.
    The assistance is part of the humanitarian and relief programs implemented by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through KSrelief to meet basic needs and improve the living and health conditions of vulnerable and disaster-affected communities worldwide.
    
    -- SPA
